description: The data access model built into .NET: abstract types in `System.Data.Common` that each database provider implements.
The supported ADO.NET provider for SQL Server, which replaces the deprecated `System.Data.SqlClient` package.
The recommended Npgsql entry point since 7.0: a thread-safe object, created once and reused, that maps to a connection pool.
A set of open physical connections kept inside the process, so disposing a connection returns it to the pool instead of closing it.
A command whose values travel separately from the SQL text, which prevents SQL injection and keeps query plans reusable.
A forward-only stream of result rows (`SqlDataReader`, `NpgsqlDataReader`) read with `ReadAsync` and typed getters such as `GetString`.
Since `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` 4.0 connections encrypt by default and validate the server certificate, so an untrusted certificate fails the connection.
